quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris provided the 2.4-meter Optical Telescope Assembly (OTA) for NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, which launched successfully, and supported the mission with radiation-hardened electronics, after more than a decade of work with NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center. Jeff Hanke (President, Space Systems): the optical eye L3Harris engineered will survey the cosmos 1,000 times faster than the Hubble Space Telescope.
